title: StudyTracker 1.1 is out
text: Dark theme is here: switch it in Settings → Appearance, it applies instantly without a reload. This Devlog is new too — updates and plans will appear here. And there is a new Support section with links to GitHub, Instagram and TikTok. Thank you for studying with StudyTracker!

title: Dark theme is ready
text: The dark theme is finished. You can switch it in Settings, and the app remembers your choice. It will arrive with version 1.1, together with this diary and a way to support the project.

title: Version 1.0.2 is out
text: Stronger password rules, clear error messages, a limit of 24 hours of study per day, and a better layout on large screens. Thanks to everyone who reported bugs!
